newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - February 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - February 10.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Police detect travel bags full of explosives on the beach off Udappuva, north of Colombo, which are believed to have been hidden by Tamil separatists, police say. ---
Navy destroys three speed boats belonging to Tamil separatists, off northern Kilinochchi seas.
Rebels launch artillery attack on Army's Vavuniya camp on Sunday.
Air Force launches fresh attacks on rebel positions in Vavuniya jungles on Sunday, defence sources say.
Ruling People's Alliance will field only talented, honest candidates at forthcoming local government elections, says President Kumaratunga. The polls are scheduled for March 27.
Navy destoys two rebel speedcraft, killing 12 guerrillas, defence sources say.
